description: This file contains PHP functions related to retrieving and formatting system vital information, including generating XML, HTML, and WML representations of system data such as hostname, IP address, kernel, distribution info, uptime, users, and CPU load.

methods.name: xml_vitals
methods.description: Generates an XML string containing various system vital information.

methods.name: html_vitals
methods.description: Creates an HTML table displaying system vital data, including hostname, IP, kernel version, uptime, users, and load average.

methods.name: wml_vitals
methods.description: Produces WML formatted data for system vitals, suitable for mobile devices.
